tasks.task_name: Interpret job instructions and plan electrical installation work
Visually inspect electrical components and identify damage or incorrect connections
Assemble or install an electrical and electronic subsystem according to job instructions
Perform appropriate electrical installation tests before energizing
Diagnose electrical installation faults and identify likely causes
Repair or replace faulty electrical installation components
Identify hazards and demonstrate safe working practices
Identify emergency procedures and appropriate first-aid responses
Communicate work information and respond appropriately in workplace situations
Demonstrate relevant digital and employability skills
